"Sam Lowry" <slowry@ministryofinformation.gov> wrote in news:wumdnT-xZ-
0dj4jcRVn-vg@bravo.net:

> ------------------------------------------------------------------------
> "By 'feelings of inferiority' we mean not only inferiority feelings in
> the strictest sense but a whole spectrum of related traits: low self-
> esteem, feelings of powerlessness, depressive tendencies, defeatism,
> guilt, self-hatred, etc.  We argue that modern leftists tend to have
> such feelings (possibly more or less repressed) and that these feelings
> are decisive in determining the direction of modern leftism."
> -- The Unabomber Manifesto; Paragraph 10
> ------------------------------------------------------------------------
> 

So what is it about the message contained in _Industrial Society And Its 
Future_ that attracts you personally?

I'll admit it's a pretty interesting work. Few nutbars as far gone as 
Kaczynski (sp?) take the time to write something worth reading - and it is 
worth a gander. I'm just curious as to what about it you personally 
identify with.

-- 
"...you're hopelessly obsessed to the point of being psychotic."
  -Tani Jantsang
